text_block_list.text:
One day, while shopping for training 
supplies with Mejiro Ramonu...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: —Oh, Ramonu and... her Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"W-Woah... Look, it's the student council 
president and the others. Those three have 
such an incredible presence..."

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Especially Air Groove-senpai and 
Ramonu-san. It's like two magnificent 
flowers blooming side by side...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Are you out shopping as well, 
Ramonu-senpai? We're also out picking up 
supplies for the student council room.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ... Um, is something the matter?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
The look in your eyes is passionate and 
wonderful.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
It matches my mother's eyeshadow. I am 
honored by your compliment.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that too, but... Deep within those 
eyes—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"—Lapis lazuli. It's very much to my 
liking."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Um, Ramonu-senpai—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Now, now, Ramonu. Please don't trouble 
them too much.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
...You're like "that" with just about 
anyone, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
However... she doesn't look troubled at 
all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Hey, Air Groove.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Forget about Rudolf and come over to my 
side instead.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Wait, just now... what did you say, 
Ramonu-san? Poaching...? Uh, to where?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...There are too many eyes here, so let's 
step outside—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Pardon me, but may I ask what you meant by 
that statement?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Capable enough for Rudolf to keep by her 
side. And having your eyes peered into by 
me...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"That strength of will to glare right back 
at me. Splendid, isn't it?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"I'd love for you to always be on standby 
as a tandem running partner."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...To ask me to hold back, how admirable 
of someone of your stature to say."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I have heard much about you. Why not bind 
them yourself with that fragrant scent?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Oh. So something like that is enough to 
tempt you.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
If you are confident you won't lose 
yourself in the fragrance of my blossoms, 
that is.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Heh... Now I want to pluck it even more.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...I'm getting a bit too carried away.

True, if this continues, things might 
develop in an unexpected direction. It's 
about time I step in. Now then—
choice_data_list:
How about an endurance running match 
instead?

text_block_list.text:
True, if this continues, things might 
develop in an unexpected direction. It's 
about time I step in. Now then—
choice_data_list:
How about an endurance running match 
instead?

text_block_list.text:
When Umamusume have something to prove to 
each other, the proper way is to settle it 
in an actual showdown.

I thought suggesting a contest between the 
two level-headed girls would cool things 
down and settle the situation. Or so I 
hoped...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: You're right. Shall we go for a run?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
The one left standing at the end receives 
the other's devotion. Understood?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Bring it on.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, please get ready. I will meet you 
at the track.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...I never expected things to develop like 
this.
choice_data_list: Maybe Ramonu just wants to run...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I imagine so... ...Let's watch how things 
go for a bit, then step in when the time 
is right.

The Student Council President stepped in 
to stop their showdown before they 
overexerted themselves... but Mejiro 
Ramonu looked thoroughly satisfied to have 
found such a great training partner.

I can't be her running partner, but I can 
find and bring in partners who satisfy her 
even more than now. That, too, is a 
Trainer's job.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Even if you don't seek me out, don't 
you already have a fine retainer, Senpai?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
That wraps up this discussion, then. Well 
then—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
No ears or tail. Nor do I have 
fast-running legs.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"It's not enough. Nothing could ever 
replace her."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: So, can you truly satisfy me, I wonder...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Don't look at me. I can't help you.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
For now, maybe it wouldn't hurt to try 
adding what's missing... perhaps?

Afterward... as a desperate measure, I put 
on the fan-made ears and tail found 
sleeping in the academy's storage and 
appeared before Mejiro Ramonu, but—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Hmm...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: You wanted to be a donkey.

Mejiro Ramonu didn't remember a thing, and 
I was a donkey...
